name: ChatGPT
scope: ChatGPT Chat and Work for brainstorming, supplied files and image creation; plan/workspace access required. Excludes dedicated Deep Research and Codex.
summary: A broad field of ideas, images and documents, with room to turn source material into competing directions.
limitation: Generated assets and source-based recommendations need review; a preservation prompt is not an exactness guarantee.

centerEvidence.claim: An illustrative brief-to-options conversation emphasizes new alternatives, then iterates toward a useful artifact.

sources.title: Use ChatGPT
sources.finding: Chat brainstorms and compares options; Work creates files, analyzes supplied material and supports review and revision.

sources.title: Image generation
sources.finding: ChatGPT generates and edits images from prompts and references; targeted revisions help control composition.

sources.title: Model strategic scenarios and tradeoffs
sources.finding: The shared ChatGPT desktop workflow compares constrained scenarios, revises assumptions and inspects tradeoffs; coding-specific UI is not scored.

N.claim: Specific revisions and reviewable finished files support bounded production; no general exact execution guarantee.

NE.claim: Supplied-file extraction and reorganization produces inspectable outputs, with human review still required.

E.claim: Files and source comparison guide outputs; evidence can be inspected but is not automatically preserved exactly.

SE.claim: Source-informed scenario comparisons keep assumptions inspectable and revisable.

S.claim: Competing scenarios can be developed and tested against changed constraints and assumptions.

SW.claim: Brainstorming several approaches and iterating them supplies substantive direction-setting.

W.claim: Text, images and interactive artifacts allow substantial compositional invention.

NW.claim: Specified image composition and targeted revisions combine invention with human-directed edits.

name: Claude
scope: Claude web/desktop chat with projects, documents, code execution and web search; Free or paid within limits. Excludes Research, Design and Claude Code workflows.
summary: Broad invention with a strong directed-writing shoulder; source-bound proposals are narrower than free exploration.
limitation: Local edits and executable files are inspectable, but prose preservation and citations still require human checking.

centerEvidence.claim: A representative workflow develops a brief into a document, then revises selected passages: modest invention with human direction.

sources.title: What are artifacts and how do I use them?
sources.finding: Documents, code and interactive artifacts support selected-text edits and branching a conversation into another direction.

sources.title: Create and edit files with Claude
sources.finding: Sandbox code execution produces downloadable files, processes supplied data, and exposes auditable actions; outputs need review.

sources.title: How can I create and manage projects?
sources.finding: Project knowledge and instructions provide reusable supplied context across chats.

sources.title: Enable and use web search
sources.finding: Web responses have source links and citations; direct links can be fetched, and important information should be cross-checked.

N.claim: Selected-passage edits and auditable file creation support checkable instructions; exact general obedience is not established.

NE.claim: A specified PDF-table extraction into a spreadsheet can be inspected beside its input; no automatic exactness guarantee.

E.claim: Cited web synthesis and auditable processing of supplied files exceed loose reference conditioning, without universal exact preservation.

SE.claim: Supplied CSV data can yield a report with recommendations, but source-bound proposal control remains prompt-led.

S.claim: Branching the conversation explores another artifact direction and permits iterative revision; strategy quality is not benchmarked.

SW.claim: Fresh document or interactive-tool directions can be explored through separate conversation branches.

W.claim: Chat creates and iteratively changes substantive documents, code and interactive content beyond fixed templates.

NW.claim: Requested structures and formatting can be realized in generated files and selected passages revised locally.

name: Gemini
scope: Gemini Apps on desktop with Canvas, uploaded briefs and code preview; sign-in required, plan limits apply. Excludes Deep Research and standalone Notebook.
summary: Briefs can branch into several formats, while selected-text edits and code previews pull the cloud upward.
limitation: Canvas versions and code changes are inspectable; converting a brief does not ensure every supplied detail survives.

centerEvidence.claim: A supplied document becomes a Canvas artifact, followed by targeted edits and preview inspection.

sources.title: Create docs, apps and more with Canvas
sources.finding: Canvas accepts uploaded material, creates multiple artifact formats, edits selected text, suggests edits, and exposes code changes and logs.

N.claim: Selected text and app regions are addressable; code changes and preview logs help inspect results.

NE.claim: A selected passage can be revised in context and compared through saved versions.

E.claim: Uploaded material conditions Canvas outputs and version history aids comparison; exact preservation is not established.

SE.claim: Suggest edits proposes changes to supplied passages, with human review and bounded scope.

S.claim: Suggested edits and alternate document-derived formats offer directions within a brief.

SW.claim: Documents can become custom apps or visuals, yielding multiple substantive forms for selection.

W.claim: Docs, apps, slides and custom visuals support new content and structure across formats.

NW.claim: Prompted app changes can target a selected region and be inspected in code and preview.

name: Microsoft Copilot
scope: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word, including licensed work-context access and edit mode; eligible subscription and organization enablement required.
summary: An existing document sets the center of gravity: local production is broad, open-ended exploration more restrained.
limitation: This is licensed Word-based Copilot, not consumer Copilot or a guarantee that every rewrite retains meaning.

centerEvidence.claim: Refining an existing work document with reviewable local changes is a representative supplied-content production workflow.

sources.title: Welcome to Copilot in Word
sources.finding: Word drafts from notes and referenced files, pressure-tests ideas, and supports local or document-wide changes with review.

sources.title: Edit content and rewrite
sources.finding: Selected text can be rewritten, formatted or converted into a table; users replace, insert separately or regenerate.

sources.title: Find references in Word file
sources.finding: Answers can link directly to relevant sections of the document.

N.claim: Specified local and document-wide edits have visible review and insertion controls.

NE.claim: A selected passage can become a user-specified table while the original remains available beside the revision.

E.claim: Document references navigate to original sections; local rewrites remain reviewable rather than exact by contract.

SE.claim: Pressure-testing ideas and comparing passages proposes revisions grounded in the current document.

S.claim: Chat critiques clarity and identifies needed decisions, supporting direction within an existing work brief.

SW.claim: Drafting outlines and regenerating passages supplies alternate content, within a document-centered workflow.

W.claim: New briefs and infographic content can be generated, though this scope centers on written deliverables.

NW.claim: Specified new sections or infographics can be inserted into a chosen document location.

name: DeepSeek
scope: Hosted DeepSeek assistant app; excludes DeepSeek Harness and API operations.
summary: The assistant is available, but its full directional profile needs stronger app-specific evidence.
limitation: Official pages verify chat, search and extraction; they do not sufficiently establish all four joint workflows.

statusEvidence.claim: Availability is confirmed. Scoring is withheld because app-specific combined control and proposal workflows could not be verified; API capabilities are not substituted.

sources.title: Download DeepSeek
sources.finding: The current official assistant is available for free; desktop Harness is separately described.

sources.title: Introducing DeepSeek App
sources.finding: The official app launch documents web search, thinking mode, file upload and text extraction.

name: Mistral
scope: Vibe Work (formerly Le Chat), paid Pro with Canvas and sandbox code interpreter; uploaded files and ordinary search. Excludes Vibe Code.
summary: A supplied dataset can become tables, recommendations and slides, with a strong controlled-production side.
limitation: Inspect code and source values; the sandbox's precise calculations do not validate every interpretation or generated recommendation.

centerEvidence.claim: Turning a CSV into an editable report and slide recommendations foregrounds supplied material with bounded production.

sources.title: Work with Files and Canvas
sources.finding: Canvas carries files into editable tables, summaries and slides, with inline edits, version tracking and a data-to-slides workflow.

sources.title: Code Interpreter
sources.finding: Paid Work runs Python and TypeScript in a sandbox for filters, calculations and file transformations; code can be shown.

sources.title: Search the web
sources.finding: Ordinary web answers provide inline source links; Deep Research is a separate skill.

sources.title: Vibe overview
sources.finding: Chat and Work merged into one experience; Work plans tasks, shows progress and accepts steering.

N.claim: Inline edits, change tracking and inspectable executed code support checkable instructions.

NE.claim: Named columns and filters can drive a code transformation with downloadable results and visible code.

E.claim: Inspectable data transformations plus cited web outputs support close audit, without universal semantic fidelity.

SE.claim: The documented data-to-slides workflow adds recommendations grounded in the uploaded table.

S.claim: A proposed task plan can be steered and revised; analytical recommendations remain draft judgments.

SW.claim: Creating briefs and iterating presentation recommendations offers new framing within a work context.

W.claim: Canvas supports substantive documents, presentations and code prototypes beyond summaries.

NW.claim: Inline prompts can direct novel sections while change tracking exposes what changed.

name: Grok
scope: Grok web/app chat with file uploads, conversational writing and Imagine image/video creation; Free or SuperGrok within limits. Excludes Grok Build, Bot and connector actions.
summary: Conversational invention and file comparison share a broad middle; exact local production has less documented control.
limitation: Long files may be summarized or processed in sections; conversational extraction is not a preservation guarantee.

centerEvidence.claim: Brainstorming and writing through back-and-forth chat is an illustrative direction-seeking default.

sources.title: Welcome to Grok
sources.finding: Grok supports conversational brainstorming and writing, file analysis and creative media; paid plans expand limits.

sources.title: Grok FAQ: Files and Data
sources.finding: Uploaded files support synthesis, comparison, extraction, rewriting and code execution; long files may be summarized and format limits apply.

N.claim: Requested file sections can be extracted and code processed; addressable edit and verification controls are less specified.

NE.claim: Asking for particular PDF tables gives inspectable extracted output, without an exact-preservation contract.

E.claim: Multi-file comparison and extraction use supplied documents, with summarization limits for long inputs.

SE.claim: Comparing supplied documents and synthesizing new content offers evidence-conditioned alternatives with coarse controls.

S.claim: Back-and-forth brainstorming and problem solving support developing and revising possible approaches.

SW.claim: Conversational brainstorming and writing generate new directions for human selection.

W.claim: Writing, synthesis and creative media allow substantive new content across several formats.

NW.claim: Rewriting supplied material into a specified style combines invention with explicit but conversational instructions.

name: Meta AI
scope: Meta AI consumer app and meta.ai: conversational creation, image editing and shopping inspiration in supported markets. Excludes staged July task agents.
summary: Personal inspiration and visual remixing spread left and downward; source preservation remains comparatively narrow.
limitation: Regional availability varies; contextual recommendations and image edits do not provide exact evidence or layout guarantees.

centerEvidence.claim: Exploring styling ideas and remixing visual prompts is an illustrative everyday creative workflow.

sources.title: Introducing the Meta AI app
sources.finding: Text or voice supports image generation/editing; the Discover feed supports prompt remixing and the web offers style controls.

sources.title: Introducing Muse Spark
sources.finding: The app and website support visual coding, styling inspiration and shopping alternatives refined by price, style or distance.

sources.title: Meta AI creative tools
sources.finding: Conversational object substitution and image refinement are described; no independent pixel-verification mechanism is supplied.

sources.title: Meta AI Does Not Just Think, It Acts
sources.finding: Task planning, slides and email/calendar actions were announced as rolling out in selected markets; excluded pending broader availability verification.

N.claim: Prompted object substitutions and style controls support inspectable edits without technical verification.

NE.claim: Changing an object while retaining the surrounding scene is a documented edit intent, not a verified pixel guarantee.

SE.claim: Shopping options can be refined against price, style and distance, a narrow grounded proposal workflow.

S.claim: Style inspiration and refined shopping alternatives develop choices within everyday creative briefs.

SW.claim: Remixed prompts and styling ideas encourage materially different visual possibilities for human selection.
